title: Material Control Supervisor
description: Official Samsung E&A material-control role for the Fadhili Gas Increment Program Project, with page metadata showing Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The role supervises material purchase officers, warehouse officers, and material control operators; supports procurement procedures; plans department activity; coordinates inland transportation and loading schedules; drafts logistics plans with procurement, construction, and project-controls teams; manages inventory, warehouse, laydown-yard, and jobsite material control; and handles material issue and handover reporting. The listing shows 1 to 6 years of experience and strong exposure to purchasing, expediting, material logistics, and supply-chain work in engineering and construction.
